summary: Juniata County steel Blaw-Knox tower, built 1923 and since removed per the register; no removal date, staffing or site description found.

facts.status_note: The register says the tower has been removed, with no date. A TopoQuest map label remains at the coordinates; no source we read describes the site now.

events.note: Register gives 1923 as the build year
Registered September 16, 2008, nominated by Henry Isenberg

evidence.supports: steel Blaw-Knox tower, built 1923, since removed
evidence.quote: This steel Blaw-Knox tower was built in 1923 and has been removed.

evidence.supports: Forest Lookouts page lists the tower under Juniata County, Pennsylvania with no notes beneath
TopoQuest entry Wagner Lookout Tower in Juniata County at the register coordinates

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. The Forest Lookouts page for Wagner has only a heading (Pennsylvania - Juniata County) and no notes. The register is the only source for the build date, design and removal, and it gives no removal year. The TopoQuest entry is a map-feature label with coordinates and elevation, not a site record. Two WebSearch calls turned up a Blaw-Knox tower built 1923 at Stony Mountain in Dauphin County; that is a different tower and is not used here. Story sits at the low end of the word range because the evidence is thin. Not tried: Juniata County historical societies, Pennsylvania DCNR records, newspaper archives. The firelookout.org Pennsylvania list returns 404 and was not checked.
